label: Eufy Security Video Doorbell S330 (dual camera)
description: Eufy Video Doorbell S330 is a 2K dual-camera doorbell (front 160-degree lens plus a low-angle package camera) with on-device person detection, storing clips on a HomeBase 2/3 rather than in the cloud. It is wireless-only: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi for the doorbell itself, with no Ethernet and no PoE; the doorbell wiring it accepts is 16-24 VAC for power, otherwise it runs on its battery pack.
